facts.fact: The World Bank states that investments in an open-source management information system (CORE-MIS) have established the foundations of Burundi's national social protection system, supporting the Merankabandi programme nationwide.
The World Bank states that investments in CORE-MIS and digital payments enable delivery of Merankabandi assistance nationwide.

The World Bank states that the Unified Social Registry, CORE-MIS and digital payments are increasingly used across sectors and by other development programmes, with the registry also used by the Soleil-Nyakiriza solar project.
